column2: SSI's original PeG focused on modern land combat circa 2005-2020.
column3: SSI 原版的 PeG 聚焦于 2005-2020 年前后的现代陆战。

column2: Fred Chlanda and Mark Kirby adapted Panzer General II (PG2) equipment files to PeG.  Mark expanded that initial work into a complete package -- PeG-WW2 -- focused on World War II combat.

column2: Narayan and Mark made the first new equipment file (actually EQUIP97.EQP which contains the parameters for each unit and EQUIP97.TXT which contains the names for each unit.)

column2: As far as I know, Madman created the first publicly available modification of the PeG e-file. That opened the door for a lot of people to explore the e-file further.  However, his e-file was essentially an add-on patch and somewhat cumbersome to use rather than a direct file replacement.  I think it was less widely used than the e-files which Narayan and Mark have made, so I’m calling theirs PeG 2.0.
column3: 据我所知，Madman 制作了第一个公开发布的 PeG 装备文件(efile)修改。这为很多人进一步研究装备文件(efile)打开了大门。不过，他的装备文件本质上是一个附加补丁，用起来相当麻烦，而不是直接替换文件。我认为它不如 Narayan 和 Mark 制作的装备文件使用得广泛，所以我把他们的称为 PeG 2.0。

column2: Narayan and Mark also created the first new GUI97 file.
column3: Narayan 和 Mark 还制作了第一个新的 GUI97 文件。

column3: 最初的 "No Alliances"（无同盟）版本实际上是把美国和中国分别作为西方同盟和东方同盟的唯一成员。也可以制作一个真正的无同盟版本，两个同盟中都不包含任何国家。

column2: Any member of the Western Alliance  can purchase elite units:  2 gold bars which start with 200 experience points.  All other countries – members of the Eastern Alliance as well as non-aligned countries – are limited to regular (green bar/0 experience points at start) and veteran (silver bar/100 experience points).
column3: 西方同盟的任何成员都可以购买精锐单位：2 条金杠，初始经验值 200 点。其他所有国家——东方同盟成员以及不结盟国家——只能使用普通（绿杠／初始经验值 0 点）和老兵（银杠／经验值 100 点）单位。

column3: 在 PeG-WW2 中，两个同盟分别名为 "Allied"（同盟）和 "Axis"（轴心）。美国是 Allied 同盟的唯一成员，纳粹德国是 Axis 同盟的唯一成员。

column2: 5)  MOVEMENT RATES TABLE

column2: The Movement Rates Table determines how many points are required by each Movement Type to move into a hex of a particular Terrain Type.
column3: 移动力表决定了每种移动类型进入某一地形类型的格需要多少点。

column2: Two new movement types have been added replacing unused ones.   Four new terrain types have been created.  Minor changes have been made in the rates for other Movement & Terrain Types.  I have made an Excel 2000 workbook that shows the whole new Movement Rates Table as well as the original one.  It includes tools for quickly comparing the new and old movement rates overall, for specific movement types or for specific terrain types.
column3: 新增了两种移动类型以替换未使用的类型。创建了四种新的地形类型。其他移动类型与地形类型的数值也有小幅改动。我制作了一个 Excel 2000 工作簿，其中展示了完整的新移动力表以及原表。它包含一些工具，可以快速比较新旧移动力：整体比较、按特定移动类型比较或按特定地形类型比较。

column2: Movement Types
column3: 移动类型

column2: The new MRT replaces two unused Movement Types – Towed and Naval – with Light Tracked (for smaller tanks & other light tracked vehicles) and Guerrilla (for irregular troops relying on leg movement or haphazard vehicle use).
column3: 新的移动力表(MRT)用轻型履带(Light Tracked)（供较小的坦克及其他轻型履带车辆使用）和游击(Guerrilla)（供依赖徒步移动或随意使用车辆的非常规部队使用）替换了两种未使用的移动类型——牵引(Towed)和海军(Naval)。

column2: Towed is not particularly useful in PeG since there are no separate transport vehicles as in PG2.
column3: 牵引在 PeG 中没什么用，因为 PeG 不像 PG2 那样有独立的运输车辆。

column2: Naval rates in PeG were exactly the same as Deep Naval and Coastal.  It’s possible that SSI originally intended the Naval movement rate to be strictly for submarines.  This would parallel the movement rates used by Pacific General.  However, unlike PacGen, PeG has no submerged status for submarines.
column3: PeG 中的海军数值与远洋(Deep Naval)和近海(Coastal)完全相同。SSI 最初可能打算把海军移动类型专用于潜艇。这会与 Pacific General 使用的移动力一致。然而，与 PacGen 不同，PeG 中的潜艇没有潜航状态。

column2: Light Tracked is capable of movement on terrains which are prohibited to Tracked (Main Battle Tanks) or which significantly slow MBTs.
column3: 轻型履带能在履带（主战坦克）禁止通行的地形上移动，也能在被主战坦克(MBT)严重拖慢的地形上移动。

column2: Guerrilla is slower than Leg in open terrain (Clear,  Airfield, & Roads) and urbanized areas (City, Dense Urban & Port).  It is faster than both Leg and even Ranger in Forest, Jungle & Mountain terrains to reflect the local knowledge and expertise of indigenous troops.  I suggest that it be used in new e-files for cheap versions of Ranger units:  excellent mobility under cover but relatively low fire power.
column3: 游击在开阔地形（开阔地、机场和道路）和城市化区域（城市、密集市区和港口）中比徒步慢。在森林、丛林和山地地形中，它比徒步甚至比游骑兵都快，以体现当地部队的本土知识和专长。我建议在新的装备文件(efile)中用游击来做廉价的游骑兵单位：在掩蔽下机动性极佳，但火力相对较低。

column2: To the best of my knowledge no units in the original PeG equipment file or Narayan’s version 2.9 e-file are affected by these changes.  It should be fairly simple to use these new movement types in new e-files.

column2: Terrain Types
column3: 地形类型

column2: The new MRT also replaces two Terrain Types – Rice Fields and Lake Regions – with Agricultural  (for fields with crops in season) and Coastal Waters (for ocean adjacent to land).  It also redefines a third – Fortification – as Dense Urban (for city centers).   A fourth terrain – Swamp – was renamed as Wetlands but it retains essentially the same movement characteristics as in the original.
column3: 新的移动力表(MRT)还用农田(Agricultural)（用于当季有作物的田地）和近岸水域(Coastal Waters)（用于与陆地相邻的海洋）替换了两种地形类型——水田(Rice Fields)和湖区(Lake Regions)。它还把第三种——工事(Fortification)——重新定义为密集市区(Dense Urban)（用于市中心）。第四种地形——沼泽(Swamp)——改名为湿地(Wetlands)，但它的移动特性与原版基本相同。

column2: 9) MODIFIED PRESTIGE PERCENTAGE
column3: 9) 修改了威望百分比

column2: The prestige percentage (PP) changes how much prestige the human player(s) or AI will receive from bonus hexes and from end-of-scenario prestige awards.  For example, if the human player is to receive 1000 points at the end of the scenario and has PP set to 150 he/she will get 1500 points (1000 X 150%).  Or if the AI’s PP is set to 25% and the end of scenario increase for the AI is 2000 points it will only get 500 points (2000 x 25%).
column3: 威望百分比(PP)决定人类玩家或 AI 从奖励格和场景结束时的威望奖励中获得多少威望。例如，如果人类玩家在场景结束时本应获得 1000 点，而 PP 设为 150，他/她将得到 1500 点（1000 X 150%）。或者如果 AI 的 PP 设为 25%，而 AI 在场景结束时的增加量为 2000 点，它只会得到 500 点（2000 x 25%）。

column2: The effect of  the prestige percentage was inaccurately presented in the original PeG.  On the campaign selection screen, clicking on the prestige percentage’s up arrow for the human player said that it "increased campaign difficulty".  Clicking on the up arrow for the AI’s prestige percentage also said that it  "increased campaign difficulty".  That was confusing to me when I started playing PeG.
column3: 在原版 PeG 中，威望百分比的效果说明并不准确。在战役选择界面上，点击人类玩家威望百分比的向上箭头时，提示为 "increased campaign difficulty"（「增加战役难度」）。点击 AI 威望百分比的向上箭头，提示同样是 "increased campaign difficulty"（「增加战役难度」）。我刚开始玩 PeG 时对此很困惑。

column2: As the examples above indicate, increasing the prestige percentage will give either the human player or the AI more prestige.  An increase for the player makes the game easier.  An increase for the AI makes the game harder.  The captions now show this correctly.
column3: 正如上面的例子所示，提高威望百分比会给人类玩家或 AI 更多的威望。为玩家提高会让游戏更容易。为 AI 提高会让游戏更难。现在标题已经正确显示了这一点。

column2: I also changed the range of the prestige percentage.  Originally it was 100-300; it is now 0-500.  At 500 the number will roll over to 0.  At 0 it will roll over to 500.
column3: 我还更改了威望百分比的范围。原来是 100-300；现在是 0-500。到 500 时数字会回绕到 0。到 0 时会回绕到 500。

column2: 11) CHANGED THE DATE RANGE ALLOWED IN SCENARIO BUILDER TO +0 TO +127 FROM BASE YEAR.
column3: 11) 将场景编辑器允许的日期范围改为从基准年份起 +0 到 +127。

column2: The Scenario Builder originally had a 20 year limit:  +1 to +20 from the base year, whether base year is 2000 or 1900.  Thus, increasing from the year 2020 rolled the calendar around to 2001.   Decreasing the year from 2001 rolls around to 2000.
column3: 场景编辑器原本有 20 年的限制：从基准年份起 +1 到 +20，无论基准年份是 2000 还是 1900。因此，从 2020 年往上增加会回绕到 2001 年。从 2001 年往下减少会回绕到 2000 年。

column2: Despite this limit,  scenarios set for December 31, 2020 have no problem changing the date to January 1, 2021.  Scenarios dates can be set beyond 2021 (or 1921 for base year 1900) using Luis Guzman’s PegSuite; there is no problem with these "over 20" dates.
column3: 尽管有这个限制，设为 2020 年 12 月 31 日的场景在把日期改到 2021 年 1 月 1 日时并没有问题。使用 Luis Guzman 的 PegSuite 可以把场景日期设到 2021 年（基准年份为 1900 时是 1921 年）以后；这些"超过 20 年"的日期没有问题。

column2: The range can now be +0 to +127 from the base year.  (In an earlier release I had only changed the maximum year.  Starting with version 2.7b the scenario can begin in +0, i.e. 2000 or 1900 depending on your base year.)
column3: 现在的范围可以是基准年份起 +0 到 +127。（在较早的发布版中，我只改了最大年份。从 2.7b 版开始，场景可以从 +0 开始，即根据你的基准年份是 2000 或 1900。）

column2: SSI originally used "Bridging" to mean both the Bridging Special Equipment (which can only be set in the equipment file), the Bridging Attachment (which is purchased during game play) and the Bridging Leader which is awarded during game play.  However the attachment and the leader are not the same as the special equipment.

column3: 架桥特种装备"当部署在河流格上时，允许其他友军单位按道路地形通过"。换句话说，这些单位就是架桥工兵。

column2: The Bridging Attachment and the Bridging Leader allow units to "cross river hexes as rough terrain and make attacks while in river hexes".  Both of these only apply to the unit which has them.

column2: But this definition is exactly the same as the definition for the River Assault Special Equipment  which allows "units with this equipment special (to) cross river hexes as rough terrain and make attacks while in river hexes."
column3: 但这个定义与渡河突击特种装备的定义完全相同，后者允许"拥有该特种装备的单位按崎岖地形穿越河流格，并可在河流格中发起攻击"。

column2: For consistency, the GUI file now refers to Bridging Special Equipment as Bridging Engineers that allow other units to cross rivers.  River Assault is used for the attachment and the leader that allow individual units to cross rivers and conduct assaults when crossing.
column3: 为保持一致，界面(GUI)文件现在把架桥特种装备称为架桥工兵，即允许其他单位渡河的单位。而渡河突击(River Assault)用于指允许单个单位渡河并在渡河时发起攻击的附件和指挥官。

column3: 渡河突击附件的图标也已更改，以体现这一点。

column2: 13)  "COMBAT SUPPORT" SPECIAL EQUIPMENT RENAMED AS "DEPLOY & SUPPLY"

column3: (17) 将场景日期范围改为 +0 到 +127

column2: The date range allowed in Scenario Builder is now +0 to +127 from base year instead of starting at +1.  (This is a revision of an earlier modification; see item 11 below.)
column3: 场景编辑器允许的日期范围现在是从基准年份起 +0 到 +127，而不再从 +1 开始。（这是对早先一项修改的修订；见下文第 11 条。）

column2: (18) ADDED EXPLANATORY LABELS FOR SOME MENU ITEMS
column3: (18) 为部分菜单项添加了说明性标签

column2: Several captions in the GUI file don't explain very well the buttons they refer to.  For example the date spinners in Scenario Builder originally just said "Set Month", "Set Day" & "Set Year".  I've changed these to indicate "Increase Month", "Decrease Month" et cetera.
column3: 界面文件中的一些标题不能很好地说明它们所指的按钮。例如，场景编辑器中的日期微调按钮原本只写着 "Set Month"（设置月份）、"Set Day"（设置日期）和 "Set Year"（设置年份）。我把它们改成表示 "Increase Month"（增加月份）、"Decrease Month"（减少月份）等含义。

column2: Nothing dramatic here -- just a little thing that SSI should have changed to make the user interface smoother.
column3: 这里没什么大不了的——只是 SSI 本来就应该改的小地方，让用户界面更顺畅。

column2: (19) EXPANDED DISPLAY OF CAM & SCN INTRO TEXT ON THE SELECTION SCREENS
column3: (19) 扩大了选择界面上 CAM 与 SCN 介绍文本的显示区域

column2: Intro text is shown when you have highlighted a scenario or campaign on the selection screen.  PeG originally displayed this text in a rectangle roughly 8 lines tall by 40 characters wide.  The exact number of lines & characters depends on which font PeG is using for display on your computer.  The intro files can be as large as the scenario/campaign designer wants but in order to read them you have to scroll up and down.
column3: 当你在选择界面上选中一个场景或战役时，会显示介绍文本。PeG 原本把这段文本显示在一个大约 8 行高、40 字符宽的矩形里。确切的字数和行数取决于 PeG 在你的电脑上使用的字体。介绍文件的大小可以随场景／战役作者的需要而定，但为了读完它们你必须上下滚动。

column2: The space provided and the scrolling seemed cumbersome to me.  The entire right half of the screen is now devoted to these intro texts.  That allows about 250-300 words of narrative text (2000-2400 characters) depending on the font which PeG uses on your computer.
column3: 在我看来，提供的空间和滚动都很麻烦。现在整个屏幕的右半边都用于显示这些介绍文本。这样大约可以容纳 250-300 个单词的叙述文本（2000-2400 个字符），具体取决于 PeG 在你电脑上使用的字体。

column2: (20) ELIMINATED THE BASE STRENGTH 15 INFANTRY FOR COUNTRIES 3,5,& 15
column3: (20) 取消了国家 3、5 和 15 的基础兵力 15 步兵

column2: PeG originally gave countries 3,5 & 15 infantry with a base strength of 15.  This has been eliminated; all countries now get infantry with base strength 10.
column3: PeG 原本给国家 3、5 和 15 基础兵力为 15 的步兵。这一点已被取消；现在所有国家的步兵基础兵力都是 10。

column2: (21) ADDED VERSION & SSI COPYRIGHT NOTICE TO SPLASH PAGE
column3: (21) 在启动画面上添加了版本与 SSI 版权声明

column2: The version name & number is now included on the splash page along with SSI copyright notice and primary credits to developer & modifier.
column3: 现在启动画面上包含了版本名称与编号，以及 SSI 版权声明和对开发者及修改者的主要致谢。

column2: As I've said in other places, this is NOT a new game it is a modified version of "People's General" developed and copyrighted by SSI.
column3: 正如我在其他地方说过的，这并非一个新游戏，而是由 SSI 开发并享有版权的 "People's General" 的修改版。

column2: (22) ENABLED EQUIPMENT FILE NAME TO BE DISPLAYED IN UPPER LEFT CORNER
column3: (22) 使装备文件名称可以显示在左上角

column2: Previously the version information provided in the GUI file was displayed in the upper left corner.
column3: 以前显示在左上角的是界面文件中提供的版本信息。

column2: With this modification the equipment file name is read from the E-file and displayed in the upper left corner.
column3: 经过这项修改，会从装备文件(efile)中读取装备文件名称并显示在左上角。

column2: *** NOTE TO E-FILE DEVELOPERS ***
column3: *** 致装备文件(efile)开发者的说明 ***

column2: Unit 00 of the e-file is an unused unit which normally says "3.7 FlaK".  If you have not already done this, please enter the name of your e-file for this unit.
column3: 装备文件(efile)中的 00 号单位是一个未使用的单位，名称通常是 "3.7 FlaK"。如果你还没有这样做，请在这个单位处填入你的装备文件的名称。

column2: (23) CHANGED TEXT COLOR TO LIGHT BROWN   (PeG-WW2 only)
column3: (23) 将文本颜色改为浅棕色   （仅 PeG-WW2）

column2: Originally the color of most text was bright green.  This looks rather odd with the light brown icons of Peg-WW2.  The standard text color is now light brown consistent with these icons.
column3: 原本大部分文本的颜色是亮绿色。这与 Peg-WW2 的浅棕色图标搭配起来相当奇怪。现在标准文本颜色是与这些图标一致的浅棕色。

column2: (24) CHANGED THE DEFAULT YEAR IN THE SCENARIO BUILDER. (PeG-WW2 only)
column3: (24) 更改了场景编辑器中的默认年份。（仅 PeG-WW2）

column2: Originally the default year in the Scenario Builder was 2005. (Actually it is '05 so 2005 for base year 2000, 1905 for base year 1900).
column3: 原本场景编辑器中的默认年份是 2005。（实际上是 '05，所以基准年份为 2000 时是 2005，基准年份为 1900 时是 1905。）

column2: Although many scenario developers use Luis Guzman's PeG Suite for a large part of the development work, some tasks are still done with PeG's own Scenario Builder.
column3: 尽管许多场景开发者使用 Luis Guzman 的 PeG Suite 完成大部分开发工作，但有些工作仍然要用 PeG 自带的场景编辑器完成。

column2: This modification uses September 1, 1939 (the invasion of Poland) as the default date for the Scenario Builder.
column3: 这项修改使用 1939 年 9 月 1 日（入侵波兰）作为场景编辑器的默认日期。

column2: (25) COUNTRIES 3,5 & 15 DO NOT GET OVER-STRENGTH INFANTRY.    (PeG-WW2 only)
column3: (25) 国家 3、5 和 15 不会获得超编步兵。    （仅 PeG-WW2）

column2: Originally the infantry units for countries 3, 5 & 15 got base strength 15 rather than base strength 10.
column3: 原本国家 3、5 和 15 的步兵单位基础兵力是 15，而不是 10。

column2: In PeG-WW2 2.7 the base strength for all units of all countries is 10.
column3: 在 PeG-WW2 2.7 中，所有国家所有单位的基础兵力都是 10。
